help.title: Where do I find this?
help.sched: Most conventions publish their schedule on Sched — the site looks like <name>.sched.com. Copy any page from it and paste it here.
help.ics: An .ics file is a standard calendar export. Conventions often link it as "Add to calendar" or "Calendar feed" — webcal:// links work too.
help.ask: Check the convention's website or app for a schedule link, or ask their social media which format they publish.

import.previewFooter: Nothing is saved until you tap Import.
